title: No More Tomatoes
setting: The kitchen of Omar's small restaurant.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Omar has a small restaurant in town.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔在镇上开了一家小餐馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) stands smiling at the door of his small restaurant on a town street.

sentences.en: Today Lily and her father help in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 今天莉莉和她爸爸在厨房帮忙。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper), both in aprons, help in a busy restaurant kitchen.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily and her father helping in the kitchen; 'today' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Her father has long legs and a funny hat.
sentences.zh: 她爸爸腿很长，戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper), wearing a funny, very tall chef's hat, stands next to Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots); his long legs make her look tiny.

sentences.en: Lily cuts the fourth and last tomato.
sentences.zh: 莉莉切了第四个，也是最后一个番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) carefully cuts a tomato on a chopping board next to three tomatoes already cut; the bowl beside her is empty.

sentences.en: Omar tries the soup, but it needs more tomatoes.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔尝了尝汤，可是还需要更多番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) tastes red soup from a big pot with a spoon and frowns; an empty tomato basket sits beside the pot.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar tasting the soup and an empty tomato basket; 'needs more' is only suggested.

sentences.en: Lily takes a pen and writes a shopping list.
sentences.zh: 莉莉拿起一支笔，写了一张购物清单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) holds a pen over a small sheet of paper with little drawings of tomatoes on it.

sentences.en: They leave for the supermarket before lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们在午饭前出发去超市。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) walk out of the restaurant towards a big supermarket across the street.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them leaving for the supermarket; 'before lunch' can't be shown.

sentences.en: When they come back, people wait at the window.
sentences.zh: 他们回来时，人们正在窗边等着。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) come back with bags full of tomatoes while hungry people wait at the restaurant window.
